_doc: The user's list of 2026-11-11 (docs/improvements11.txt), its third phase, read by 918 spells3 / slashes3 and written onto every map of the game. cantrip: the casters' starting fire bolt costs nothing (its damage grows with her tier as every spell's: TierSpellMul). looks: three spells' effects from the Fab vault's packs (screened in play: Magic Projectiles Vol. 5's shooting star and sun, VortexNiagaraFX's void, AbsorbtionFX's inward bursts). elements: a spell's element by a word of its name (Elemental Ruin's). curses: the Warlock's own (OnlyHeroes), each a Curse spell with its CurseEffect, its place among the dungeons' thirty tiers (slot: dungeon (slot-1)//5's tier (slot-1)%5+1; 12 of them where the Warlock learns nothing else, Doom beside Starfall), mana 12 + 6 x slot; amount / duration / radius / count as the user's table; fx by asset name (918 finds them in the packs). slashes: ten more for the Warrior, two to each tier, trail slashes on her blade (WeaponSlashFX's static-mesh versions) and an unused Magic Projectiles hit.

curses.name: Curse of Rot
curses.text: one enemy loses 6% of its hit points as poison over 8 s; up to 3 at once

curses.name: Hex of Lethargy
curses.text: enemies in an area 30% slower and their blows 15% slower for 6 s

curses.name: Mark of the Hunted
curses.text: one enemy seen through walls; your blows on it 10% likelier to strike twice as hard, for 20 s; one mark at a time

curses.name: Withering Brand
curses.text: the enemy gets half the healing and none of its own regeneration for 10 s

curses.name: Curse of Silence
curses.text: the enemy can't shoot, cast or use abilities for 3 s (1.5 s an elite or a boss)

curses.name: Curse of Brittle Bones
curses.text: the enemy takes 25% more from weapons for 8 s, and a blow of yours that strikes twice as hard knocks it down

curses.name: Curse of Greed
curses.text: killed while cursed, the enemy drops 50% more gold and has a 15% chance of a thing besides

curses.name: Leech Hex
curses.text: 15% of all hurt dealt to the enemy (by anyone) heals you, for 10 s

curses.name: Curse of Dread
curses.text: enemies in an area flee in fear for 3 s and take 15% more; one that takes a tenth of its hit points stops

curses.name: Contagion
curses.text: when the cursed enemy dies, all its curses jump to up to 3 enemies within 8 m with the time they had left

curses.name: Elemental Ruin
curses.text: the enemy takes 40% more from one element for 12 s: fire, frost, shock or shadow, the element of the spell you cast last

curses.name: Chains of Kinship
curses.text: up to 4 enemies bound for 8 s: 30% of what one takes is split among the others

curses.name: Doom
curses.text: after 10 s the enemy takes half of all it took meanwhile; under a fifth of its hit points before that it dies (a boss takes the burst)

slashes.name: Rending Slash
slashes.text: a bleed: 40% of the hit over 4 s, stacking

slashes.name: Gust Slash
slashes.text: cleaves: every enemy before you within 3 m takes half the hit

slashes.name: Thorn Slash
slashes.text: the enemy's blows 20% weaker for 5 s

slashes.name: Spark Slash
slashes.text: the hit echoes: half of it again a moment later

slashes.name: Sundering Slash
slashes.text: the enemy takes 15% more from everything for 6 s

slashes.name: Riptide Slash
slashes.text: a whirl: every enemy round you within 3.5 m takes half the hit

slashes.name: Quake Slash
slashes.text: the ground shakes: every enemy within 3 m held for 1 s (each once in 4 s)

slashes.name: Headsman's Slash
slashes.text: an enemy under 30% of its hit points takes the hit twice

slashes.name: Warcry Slash
slashes.text: a kill with it gives you 12% of your hit points back

slashes.name: Soulfire Slash
slashes.text: a kill with it bursts: every enemy within 3.5 m takes 60% of the hit
